purpose: Pre-registers the live A/B comparison of gap-analysis judge-call PAIR BATCHING (research/gap_analysis.py grouping claims into GAP_ANALYSIS_BATCH_SIZE=2 requests via grounding_eval.judge.judge_claims_batch) against the unbatched CONTROL (GAP_ANALYSIS_BATCH_SIZE=1), BEFORE any live pair-batching timing data exists - this is the LAST Phase-9 optimization experiment (see artifacts/v2/phase9_next_optimization_decision.json for why this candidate was selected over batch_size=4/full-answer/synthesis-consolidation/report-generation-redesign/cache/retry-policy, all explicitly out of scope for this phase).
prior_experiment_this_builds_on: artifacts/v2/phase9_gap_analysis_concurrency_experiment.json (GAP_ANALYSIS_MAX_CONCURRENCY=1 confirmed as final; batching is evaluated independently, NOT combined with concurrency>1 in this phase)

control.description: Unbatched baseline - every scheduled claim judged with its own, unmodified single-claim grounding_eval.judge.judge_claim_semantic call. This is the current production default.

candidate.description: Bounded pair-batched judge dispatch via grounding_eval.judge.judge_claims_batch - 2 claims per logical Cerebras request, each strictly isolated to its own cited Evidence, explicitly claim_id-tagged (never positional association). An odd trailing claim uses the ordinary single-claim path.

held_constant.note: Batching is NOT combined with concurrency>1 in this phase - GAP_ANALYSIS_MAX_CONCURRENCY stays 1 throughout this experiment, isolating batch_size as the only independent variable.

production_default_change_policy: Do NOT change the production default until live results justify it, per this experiment's own pre-registered candidate_selection rollback criteria (mirroring the concurrency experiment's identical policy).

deterministic_validation_status.pair_batching_unit_tests: tests/test_phase9_pair_batching.py - 29/29 passed (grouping, odd-count handling, ID validation, retry-bounding, whole-batch-failure semantics, budget accounting under batching, ordering/contamination isolation)
deterministic_validation_status.semantic_equivalence_on_frozen_fixtures: PASSED - batch_size=1 vs batch_size=2 produce identical gaps/claim_judge_calls_used/ordering on SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE frozen fixtures with judge responses held fixed; logical call counts matched ceil(n/2) exactly (SMALL 4->2, MEDIUM 5->3, LARGE 6->3)
deterministic_validation_status.full_offline_regression: See docs/v2/PHASE9_RELIABILITY_PERFORMANCE.md's final-freeze-pass section for the exact pass count recorded after this file was written.

durable_fixtures_used: artifacts/v2/phase9_gap_analysis_frozen_fixtures.json (SMALL=4/MEDIUM=5/LARGE=6 judge-eligible claims - identical fixtures used by the prior concurrency experiment, for direct comparability)

planned_live_call_accounting.note: CONTROL is re-run CONTEMPORANEOUSLY in this pass (not reused from the historical concurrency-experiment batch1 timings) so the batch1-vs-batch2 latency comparison is not confounded by day-to-day provider latency drift - per this pass's explicit 'do not reuse only historical batch1 timings as causal baseline' requirement. The historical concurrency-experiment batch1 numbers remain available as a HISTORICAL cross-check only.

execution_order_rationale: Balanced/interleaved order alternating which condition runs first per fixture (SMALL: 1-then-2; MEDIUM: 2-then-1; LARGE: 1-then-2) to avoid systematically confounding batch_size with run position / time-of-day provider drift, mirroring the concurrency experiment's rotation design. Fixed and stored BEFORE any run - not modified afterward.
rerun_policy: No rerun of any completed measurement is permitted, even if inconvenient, unless a run is infrastructure-invalid (e.g. a crash before any judge call completes) - such a case must be preserved with its failure recorded, never silently deleted.

reject_batch_size_2_if_any_of: Evidence contamination (a claim's support attributable to another co-batched claim's Evidence)
false support attributable to batching (an unsupported/contradicted claim becomes supported due to cross-claim context leakage)
materially worse judgment agreement vs the contemporaneous batch_size=1 control on the SAME claims
unsafe malformed-response behavior (a fabricated judgment, a silently-dropped claim, or a silent fallback to individual calls)
retry amplification that eliminates the practical call-count reduction
candidate_selection_rollback_criteria.select_batch_size_2_only_if: a meaningful latency reduction is observed with zero semantic/safety regression from the list above

explicit_non_fabrication_notice: No field under metrics_to_collect has ever been populated with a real or placeholder number as of this file's creation. All are null by design at pre-registration time. This file must not be edited to add fabricated timing/result values before the live benchmark actually runs.
